name: Anteats
subtitle: UCI dining, campus & study
promotional_text: Live UCI menus, campus food hours, library busyness, widgets, and opening alerts — built by an Anteater.
description:
Anteats is the unofficial UCI companion for eating and finding a quiet place to study — in one native iOS app.

EAT
• Live menus for The Anteatery and Brandywine with calories, allergens, and dietary filters (Vegan, Vegetarian, Halal, Kosher, Gluten-Free)
• Countdowns like “Dinner starts in 16m,” browse tomorrow’s menu, and land on the meal happening right now
• Full nutrition on dishes (macros + expandable label/ingredients)
• Build today’s plate with a running calorie/protein tally
• Favorite dishes and get a ping when they’re being served

CAMPUS
• Hours and open/closed for Starbucks, Panda, Subway, Zot N Go, food courts, and more
• Filter by category or “open now”; opening alerts for the spots you care about
• Retail menus when venues publish them

STUDY
• Library occupancy floor by floor (live Waitz), with a quietest-right-now pick and today’s LibCal hours

WIDGETS & MORE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen / StandBy widgets for halls, today’s menu, favorites on the board, campus open count / next open, and quietest library
• Live Activity meal countdown on Dynamic Island
• Full dark mode · no accounts · no ads · no tracking

Unofficial student project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UC Irvine. Data comes from public campus endpoints that may change.
whats_new: Rate dishes with stars and see Hits at the top of Eat. Home Screen widgets follow Dark Mode. Favorite alerts fire once per dish per meal. Halls with nothing on the board show closed or next meal instead of “menu not posted.” Campus hours, Eat day picker, and Study polish. Gym stays removed.
review_notes:
No login or account is required. The app reads public endpoints only (Anteater API dining, Dining Hub campus food, Waitz library occupancy, LibCal library hours). Preferences and My Plate stay on-device (UserDefaults / App Group). Privacy Nutrition Label: Data Not Collected; PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is in the app and widget targets.

There is NO Gym tab in this build. ARC gym busyness was removed until live sensors exist — reviewers should not expect a Gym tab or ARC crowdedness charts.

Demo path for review:
1. Open the Eat tab — menus load for today’s meal. Optional: Filters chip + Clear when filters are on; scroll to Available all day (collapsed disclosure).
2. Tap a dish — blue Add to My Plate (or + on a row); Favorites heart is secondary.
3. Open My Plate via the My Plate chip (empty) or blue tally bar (filled). Remove with minus / Remove from My Plate; Clear plate confirms for 2+ dishes.
4. Campus — tap any place (blue Menu label) for the menu sheet or an honest empty/error with Retry.
5. Settings (gear) → Notifications — enable an alert path to reveal Send test notification; optionally enable Opening alerts. Data Sources lists each public feed.
6. Study — quietest library + Today’s hours (Langson + Science).
7. Optional: Home Screen widgets (Dining Halls, Today’s Menu, Favorites Today, Campus Open Now, Quietest Library).

Privacy: Data Not Collected in App Store Connect (must be Published by the account holder). Unofficial student project; not affiliated with UC Irvine.
